description: This PHP class CandidateDecorator in the Entity\Decorator namespace adds additional behaviors to the Candidate entity, including setting an 'AddedPerson' by ID and formatting the application date. It uses traits for ORM helper functions and date-time formatting.

classes.name: CandidateDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class that adds additional behaviors to the Candidate entity, including setting related Employee entities and formatting dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Candidate entity.

methods.name: setAddedPersonById
methods.description: Sets the 'added person' for the candidate based on an employee ID.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of application for the candidate.
